1	\section{Method}
2	\label{sec:method}
3	
4	\subsection{Problem Formulation}
5	\label{sec:formulation}
6	
7	A generation operator $G_\delta$ (LLM + decoding strategy $\delta$) produces successive generations $X \to Y_1 \to \cdots \to Y_K$, where $Y_k = G_\delta(Y_{k-1})$ and $Y_0 \triangleq X$ (Figure~\ref{fig:pipeline}).
8	This sequence forms a Markov chain.
9	By the Data Processing Inequality, $I(X; Y_1) \geq I(X; Y_2) \geq \cdots \geq 0$: the original signal degrades monotonically.
10	Together with Markov chain convergence, this motivates a finite $\Ktheory$ beyond which adjacent generations become indistinguishable; DPI guarantees existence but does not bound $\Ktheory$.
11	Specifically, DPI constrains the cumulative divergence from the seed text; the adjacent-pair convergence that determines $\Kempirical$ follows from the chain's approach to its stationary distribution~\cite{levin2017markov}, where successive transition distributions become indistinguishable.
12	The actual saturation depth must therefore be measured empirically.
13	
14	We define the operational lower bound $K^*_{\text{empirical}}$ (hereafter $\Kempirical$):
15	\begin{equation}
16	  \Kempirical = \max\!\bigl\{k \!\geq\! 1 : \mathrm{CI}_{\mathrm{low}}(\auc_{j\text{-}1,j}) > \theta,\ \forall j \!\leq\! k\bigr\},
17	  \label{eq:kstar}
18	\end{equation}
19	where $\mathrm{CI}_{\mathrm{low}}(\auc_{k-1,k})$ is the lower bound of a 95\% bootstrap confidence interval (1{,}000 resamples\footnote{We use 1{,}000 resamples as the default for computational efficiency; arXiv cross-scorer CIs (Table~\ref{tab:arxiv_crossscorer_ci}) use 10{,}000 to achieve tighter bounds at marginal boundaries where sub-pp differences determine the $\Kempirical{=}2$ vs.\ $\Kempirical{=}3$ verdict.}) over the pairwise AUC (Area Under the ROC Curve) between depths $k{-}1$ and $k$, and $\theta = 0.60$ is a post-hoc operational threshold (motivated below).
20	This criterion ensures that $\Kempirical$ reflects statistically robust discriminability; the $\forall j \leq k$ constraint is naturally satisfied because $\auc_{k,k+1}$ decreases monotonically above $\theta$ across all tested configurations (Table~\ref{tab:kstar_ci}).
21	While non-monotonic $\auc_{k,k+1}$ is theoretically possible if intermediate generations traverse a high-entropy transient region, we observe strict monotonicity above $\theta$ across all 37 configurations (Table~\ref{tab:kstar_ci_extended}).
22	$\Kempirical$ is jointly conditioned on the feature set and $\theta$; the domain ordering is stable across $\theta \in [0.575, 0.65]$ (Section~\ref{sec:kstar_boundary}). We verify that non-boundary CI upper bounds fall below $\theta$.
23	
24	\paragraph{Threshold choice.}
25	We set $\theta{=}0.60$ at the empirical AUC discontinuity (Figure~\ref{fig:kstar_theta}): 1v2 values cluster at $0.61$--$0.70$ while 2v3 values cluster at $0.55$--$0.59$, creating a ${\sim}$5--11\,pp gap; a 10{,}000-iteration permutation test confirms $p < 0.002$ for all boundary comparisons.
26	While optimal threshold selection methods exist (e.g., Youden's J statistic; \cite{youden1950index}), we select $\theta$ at this discontinuity because our goal is to identify a natural gap in discriminability rather than to maximize classification performance.
27	$\Kempirical{=}2$ is stable across $\theta \in [0.55, 0.65]$ for all but two marginal configurations (Table~\ref{tab:kstar_ci_extended}); only at extremes does $\Kempirical$ shift ($\theta{=}0.55$: $\Kempirical{=}3$ for two Qwen configs; $\theta{=}0.70$: $\Kempirical{=}1$).
28	The downstream filtering evaluation (Section~\ref{sec:filtering}) uses OBD without re-optimizing $\theta$, avoiding circularity.
29	A leave-one-family-out (LOFO) cross-validation yields $\hat{\theta} \in [0.5725, 0.6004]$ with 8/9 $\Kempirical$ predictions matching; arXiv corroborates with 6/6 agreement (Appendix~\ref{sec:theta_lofo}).
30	
31	
32	\subsection{Features and Classifier}
33	\label{sec:features}
34	
35	Each document is characterized by a 15-dimensional feature vector spanning four groups: \emph{surprisal moments} (mean, std, skewness, kurtosis; 4~dims), \emph{surprisal derivatives} (mean and std of first- and second-order differences, plus first-order skewness; 5~dims), \emph{vocabulary diversity} (type-token ratio, hapax legomena ratio, self-BLEU; 3~dims), and \emph{frequency tail statistics} (frequency kurtosis, entropy, rare token fraction; 3~dims).
36	All features are computed from token-level surprisal values via an external scorer model (Table~\ref{tab:s5_features}).
37	Self-BLEU is computed within each CV fold to prevent leakage; removing it reduces mean $\auc_{1v2}$ by ${<}\,1$\,pp ($\Kempirical$ unchanged; Table~\ref{tab:selfbleu_ablation}).
38	Hand-crafted features enable cross-generator transfer and permit attribution of discriminative power to specific text properties.
39	
40	We use \emph{Ordinal Binary Decomposition} (OBD), decomposing the $(K{+}1)$-class problem into $K$ cumulative binary sub-classifiers, each estimating $P(\text{depth} > k \mid \mathbf{x})$ via LightGBM~\cite{ke2017lightgbm} (hyperparameters in Table~\ref{tab:s6_lgbm_params}).
41	OBD achieves lower MAE than multiclass LightGBM (e.g., 0.984 vs.\ 1.016 on Qwen-rewrite) while maintaining superior pairwise $\auc$ (mean 0.6095 vs.\ 0.4883 for ordinal logistic regression).
42	
43	\subsection{Experimental Setup}

47	Default decoding: nucleus $p{=}0.95$, $T{=}1.0$; ablation covers greedy, $T{=}0.7$, and $T{=}1.2$.

\section{Method}
\label{sec:method}

\subsection{Problem Formulation}
\label{sec:formulation}

A generation operator $G_\delta$ (LLM + decoding strategy $\delta$) produces successive generations $X \to Y_1 \to \cdots \to Y_K$, where $Y_k = G_\delta(Y_{k-1})$ and $Y_0 \triangleq X$ (Figure~\ref{fig:pipeline}).
This sequence forms a Markov chain.
By the Data Processing Inequality, $I(X; Y_1) \geq I(X; Y_2) \geq \cdots \geq 0$: the original signal degrades monotonically.
Together with Markov chain convergence, this motivates a finite $\Ktheory$ beyond which adjacent generations become indistinguishable; DPI guarantees existence but does not bound $\Ktheory$.
Specifically, DPI constrains the cumulative divergence from the seed text; the adjacent-pair convergence that determines $\Kempirical$ follows from the chain's approach to its stationary distribution~\cite{levin2017markov}, where successive transition distributions become indistinguishable.
The actual saturation depth must therefore be measured empirically.

We define the operational lower bound $K^*_{\text{empirical}}$ (hereafter $\Kempirical$):
\begin{equation}
  \Kempirical = \max\!\bigl\{k \!\geq\! 1 : \mathrm{CI}_{\mathrm{low}}(\auc_{j\text{-}1,j}) > \theta,\ \forall j \!\leq\! k\bigr\},
  \label{eq:kstar}
\end{equation}
where $\mathrm{CI}_{\mathrm{low}}(\auc_{k-1,k})$ is the lower bound of a 95\% bootstrap confidence interval (1{,}000 resamples\footnote{We use 1{,}000 resamples as the default for computational efficiency; arXiv cross-scorer CIs (Table~\ref{tab:arxiv_crossscorer_ci}) use 10{,}000 to achieve tighter bounds at marginal boundaries where sub-pp differences determine the $\Kempirical{=}2$ vs.\ $\Kempirical{=}3$ verdict.}) over the pairwise AUC (Area Under the ROC Curve) between depths $k{-}1$ and $k$, and $\theta = 0.60$ is a post-hoc operational threshold (motivated below).
This criterion ensures that $\Kempirical$ reflects statistically robust discriminability; the $\forall j \leq k$ constraint is naturally satisfied because $\auc_{k,k+1}$ decreases monotonically above $\theta$ across all tested configurations (Table~\ref{tab:kstar_ci}).
While non-monotonic $\auc_{k,k+1}$ is theoretically possible if intermediate generations traverse a high-entropy transient region, we observe strict monotonicity above $\theta$ across all 37 configurations (Table~\ref{tab:kstar_ci_extended}).
$\Kempirical$ is jointly conditioned on the feature set and $\theta$; the domain ordering is stable across $\theta \in [0.575, 0.65]$ (Section~\ref{sec:kstar_boundary}). We verify that non-boundary CI upper bounds fall below $\theta$.

\paragraph{Threshold choice.}
We set $\theta{=}0.60$ at the empirical AUC discontinuity (Figure~\ref{fig:kstar_theta}): 1v2 values cluster at $0.61$--$0.70$ while 2v3 values cluster at $0.55$--$0.59$, creating a ${\sim}$5--11\,pp gap; a 10{,}000-iteration permutation test confirms $p < 0.002$ for all boundary comparisons.
While optimal threshold selection methods exist (e.g., Youden's J statistic; \cite{youden1950index}), we select $\theta$ at this discontinuity because our goal is to identify a natural gap in discriminability rather than to maximize classification performance.
$\Kempirical{=}2$ is stable across $\theta \in [0.55, 0.65]$ for all but two marginal configurations (Table~\ref{tab:kstar_ci_extended}); only at extremes does $\Kempirical$ shift ($\theta{=}0.55$: $\Kempirical{=}3$ for two Qwen configs; $\theta{=}0.70$: $\Kempirical{=}1$).
The downstream filtering evaluation (Section~\ref{sec:filtering}) uses OBD without re-optimizing $\theta$, avoiding circularity.
A leave-one-family-out (LOFO) cross-validation yields $\hat{\theta} \in [0.5725, 0.6004]$ with 8/9 $\Kempirical$ predictions matching; arXiv corroborates with 6/6 agreement (Appendix~\ref{sec:theta_lofo}).


\subsection{Features and Classifier}
\label{sec:features}

Each document is characterized by a 15-dimensional feature vector spanning four groups: \emph{surprisal moments} (mean, std, skewness, kurtosis; 4~dims), \emph{surprisal derivatives} (mean and std of first- and second-order differences, plus first-order skewness; 5~dims), \emph{vocabulary diversity} (type-token ratio, hapax legomena ratio, self-BLEU; 3~dims), and \emph{frequency tail statistics} (frequency kurtosis, entropy, rare token fraction; 3~dims).
All features are computed from token-level surprisal values via an external scorer model (Table~\ref{tab:s5_features}).
Self-BLEU is computed within each CV fold to prevent leakage; removing it reduces mean $\auc_{1v2}$ by ${<}\,1$\,pp ($\Kempirical$ unchanged; Table~\ref{tab:selfbleu_ablation}).
Hand-crafted features enable cross-generator transfer and permit attribution of discriminative power to specific text properties.

We use \emph{Ordinal Binary Decomposition} (OBD), decomposing the $(K{+}1)$-class problem into $K$ cumulative binary sub-classifiers, each estimating $P(\text{depth} > k \mid \mathbf{x})$ via LightGBM~\cite{ke2017lightgbm} (hyperparameters in Table~\ref{tab:s6_lgbm_params}).
OBD achieves lower MAE than multiclass LightGBM (e.g., 0.984 vs.\ 1.016 on Qwen-rewrite) while maintaining superior pairwise $\auc$ (mean 0.6095 vs.\ 0.4883 for ordinal logistic regression).

\subsection{Experimental Setup}
\label{sec:experimental_setup}

We evaluate ten configurations spanning six architecture families (1B--14B; Table~\ref{tab:setup}), each generating $K{=}5$ depth levels from 5{,}000 C4~\cite{raffel2020t5} seeds (256 tokens; 30{,}000 documents per configuration).
Default decoding: nucleus $p{=}0.95$, $T{=}1.0$; ablation covers greedy, $T{=}0.7$, and $T{=}1.2$.
Continuation mode truncates seeds to 128 tokens and extends to 256; rewrite mode paraphrases the full text.
Evaluation: 5-fold GroupKFold cross-validation grouped by seed document; pairwise $\auc$ as primary metric.

\begin{table}[t]
\centering
\small
\caption{Experimental configurations for depth-chain generation. \textbf{Config}: shorthand identifier; \textbf{Model}: architecture and parameter count; \textbf{Mode}: generation strategy (continuation or rewrite); $N$: number of seed documents per depth level.}
\label{tab:setup}
\resizebox{\columnwidth}{!}{%
\begin{tabular}{llcc}
\toprule
\textbf{Config} & \textbf{Model} & \textbf{Mode} & $N$ \\
\midrule
Qwen-rw   & Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct & Rewrite & 5{,}000 \\
Qwen-cont & Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct & Continuation & 5{,}000 \\
Qwen-base & Qwen2.5-1.5B          & Continuation & 5{,}000 \\
Pythia    & Pythia-1.4B            & Continuation & 5{,}000 \\
OLMo      & OLMo-1B               & Continuation & 5{,}000 \\
Gemma     & Gemma-2-2B            & Continuation & 5{,}000 \\
Qwen-7B   & Qwen2.5-7B            & Continuation & 5{,}000 \\
Qwen-14B  & Qwen2.5-14B           & Continuation & 5{,}000 \\
LLaMA-8B  & LLaMA-3.1-8B          & Continuation & 5{,}000 \\
Mistral   & Mistral-7B            & Continuation & 5{,}000 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}}
\end{table}

11	# 审稿报告：Generational Depth Estimation of Recursive Synthetic Text: Measuring the Discrimination Boundary
12	
13	**Venue**: EMNLP 2026 (ARR May 2026)  |  **Deadline**: 2026-05-25  |  **Round**: 1 (Fresh Review)
14	**Reviewers**: R1 (方法论 + 实验严谨性), R2 (新颖性 + 完整性 + 写作)
15	**格式确认**: Long paper, 正文 8 页 ✓, ACL 2026 review 模板 ✓, Double-blind ✓
16	
17	---
18	
19	## Summary
20	
21	本文提出 generational depth estimation 框架，定义 discrimination boundary K* 为统计分类器能可靠区分相邻生成深度的最大深度。使用 15 维 surprisal 统计特征配合 OBD-LightGBM 分类器，在 10 种模型配置（6 个架构家族，≤14B）、4 个域（C4, Wikipedia, arXiv, Code）上系统测量 K*。核心发现：web text 的 K*=2（θ=0.60），域排序 arXiv(3) > C4(2) = Code(2) > Wikipedia(1) 跨模型稳定，跨模型迁移在聚合层面保留 80-92% 但边界级别脆弱（4/6 off-diagonal 7B pairs fall below θ），fine-tuned DeBERTa 可将 K* 推高至 3-4（域依赖的 feature-set-dependent two-tier structure）。
22	
23	---
24	
25	## Strengths
26	
27	**S1. 新颖且可操作的问题定义** [R1, R2 共识]
28	将 AI 生成文本检测从二元判别推向有序多类（generational depth），K* 作为离散边界指标具有直接的 data curation 操作价值。在 model collapse 文献（训练退化趋势）和 AI 文本检测（二元判别）之间开辟了新问题空间。
29	
30	**S2. 实验规模与系统性** [R1, R2 共识]
31	10 种生成配置 × 6 架构家族 × 4 域 × 4 解码策略，配合 bootstrap 95% CI、置换检验、PELT changepoint 分析、LOFO 交叉验证、统计功效分析。20 页附录提供详尽的消融和 robustness check，远超同类工作的覆盖范围。
32	
33	**S3. Cross-family scoring 控制** [R1]
34	识别并系统控制了 same-family scoring 导致的 K* 膨胀（如 Wikipedia 上 Qwen same-family K*=2 vs cross-family K*=1），消除了一个容易被忽视但对结果有重大影响的混淆变量。
35	
36	**S4. 域排序发现的理论启发性** [R2]
37	arXiv(K*=3) > C4(K*=2) = Code(K*=2) > Wikipedia(K*=1) 的 θ-invariant 排序揭示了域结构复杂度与可区分深度的关系，对 data curation 有直接指导意义。
38	
39	**S5. Marginal cases 的诚实报告** [R1]
40	明确报告 4/7 continuation-mode 配置 CI lower bound 距 θ 不足 1pp，boundary-level transfer 的脆弱性。透明度值得肯定。
41	
42	**S6. Feature-set-dependent two-tier structure** [R1]
43	DeBERTa 在 arXiv 上 K*=3-4 表明 K* 本质上是 feature set 和 domain 的函数，这一发现对 K* 的正确解释具有重要意义。
44	
45	---
46	
47	## Weaknesses
48	
49	### Must-Fix（影响接收决定，4 项）
50	
51	**C1. DPI 理论论证与经验方法之间存在逻辑跳跃** [R1-W3 + R2-N1, 交叉共识 AGREE]
52	- **位置**: Section 3.1, Section 6
53	- DPI 保证的是完整分布上互信息的单调递减，但论文使用的是 15 维 surprisal 特征空间中的 pairwise AUC。从 DPI 到"特定特征空间中分类器性能单调递减"之间缺少形式化桥梁。Section 6 自己承认 "DPI guarantees existence but does not bound K*_neural"，但 Section 3.1 仍使用 "guarantee" 等强措辞。两位 Reviewer 独立指出此问题，交叉后维持 critical。
54	- **建议**: 将 DPI 明确定位为 motivation 而非 formal guarantee，调整 Section 3.1 措辞；补充讨论 surprisal 统计量作为互信息损失 proxy 的合理性。
55	
56	**C2. θ=0.60 的 post-hoc 选择使 K*=2 核心结论脆弱** [R1-N1 + R2-W5, 交叉共识 AGREE]
57	- **位置**: Section 3.1, Figure 3, Section 4.1
58	- θ=0.60 是在观察 1v2 和 2v3 AUC 分布后选择的 post-hoc 阈值。4/7 continuation-mode 配置 CI lower bound 距 θ 不足 1pp（Qwen-cont 仅 0.2pp，OLMo-1B 仅 0.5pp），θ 上移 0.5pp 即可翻转多个 K* 判定。AUC=0.60 本身代表的分类能力很弱（仅略高于随机的 0.50）。R1 原评 critical，R2 原评 should-fix 后在交叉中同意升级。
59	- **建议**: 增加系统性 θ-sensitivity 表格（各配置在 θ∈{0.55, 0.575, 0.60, 0.625, 0.65} 下的 K*）；报告 Youden's J 选择的 θ_optimal 及对应 K*；Abstract/Conclusion 加入 "at θ=0.60" 的明确限定；讨论 AUC=0.60 对应的实际分类表现。
60

# 审稿报告：Generational Depth Estimation of Recursive Synthetic Text: Measuring the Discrimination Boundary

**Venue**: EMNLP 2026 (ARR May 2026)  |  **Deadline**: 2026-05-25  |  **Round**: 1 (Fresh Review)
**Reviewers**: R1 (方法论 + 实验严谨性), R2 (新颖性 + 完整性 + 写作)
**格式确认**: Long paper, 正文 8 页 ✓, ACL 2026 review 模板 ✓, Double-blind ✓

---

## Summary

本文提出 generational depth estimation 框架，定义 discrimination boundary K* 为统计分类器能可靠区分相邻生成深度的最大深度。使用 15 维 surprisal 统计特征配合 OBD-LightGBM 分类器，在 10 种模型配置（6 个架构家族，≤14B）、4 个域（C4, Wikipedia, arXiv, Code）上系统测量 K*。核心发现：web text 的 K*=2（θ=0.60），域排序 arXiv(3) > C4(2) = Code(2) > Wikipedia(1) 跨模型稳定，跨模型迁移在聚合层面保留 80-92% 但边界级别脆弱（4/6 off-diagonal 7B pairs fall below θ），fine-tuned DeBERTa 可将 K* 推高至 3-4（域依赖的 feature-set-dependent two-tier structure）。

---

## Strengths

**S1. 新颖且可操作的问题定义** [R1, R2 共识]
将 AI 生成文本检测从二元判别推向有序多类（generational depth），K* 作为离散边界指标具有直接的 data curation 操作价值。在 model collapse 文献（训练退化趋势）和 AI 文本检测（二元判别）之间开辟了新问题空间。

**S2. 实验规模与系统性** [R1, R2 共识]
10 种生成配置 × 6 架构家族 × 4 域 × 4 解码策略，配合 bootstrap 95% CI、置换检验、PELT changepoint 分析、LOFO 交叉验证、统计功效分析。20 页附录提供详尽的消融和 robustness check，远超同类工作的覆盖范围。

**S3. Cross-family scoring 控制** [R1]
识别并系统控制了 same-family scoring 导致的 K* 膨胀（如 Wikipedia 上 Qwen same-family K*=2 vs cross-family K*=1），消除了一个容易被忽视但对结果有重大影响的混淆变量。

**S4. 域排序发现的理论启发性** [R2]
arXiv(K*=3) > C4(K*=2) = Code(K*=2) > Wikipedia(K*=1) 的 θ-invariant 排序揭示了域结构复杂度与可区分深度的关系，对 data curation 有直接指导意义。

**S5. Marginal cases 的诚实报告** [R1]
明确报告 4/7 continuation-mode 配置 CI lower bound 距 θ 不足 1pp，boundary-level transfer 的脆弱性。透明度值得肯定。

**S6. Feature-set-dependent two-tier structure** [R1]
DeBERTa 在 arXiv 上 K*=3-4 表明 K* 本质上是 feature set 和 domain 的函数，这一发现对 K* 的正确解释具有重要意义。

---

## Weaknesses

### Must-Fix（影响接收决定，4 项）

**C1. DPI 理论论证与经验方法之间存在逻辑跳跃** [R1-W3 + R2-N1, 交叉共识 AGREE]
- **位置**: Section 3.1, Section 6
- DPI 保证的是完整分布上互信息的单调递减，但论文使用的是 15 维 surprisal 特征空间中的 pairwise AUC。从 DPI 到"特定特征空间中分类器性能单调递减"之间缺少形式化桥梁。Section 6 自己承认 "DPI guarantees existence but does not bound K*_neural"，但 Section 3.1 仍使用 "guarantee" 等强措辞。两位 Reviewer 独立指出此问题，交叉后维持 critical。
- **建议**: 将 DPI 明确定位为 motivation 而非 formal guarantee，调整 Section 3.1 措辞；补充讨论 surprisal 统计量作为互信息损失 proxy 的合理性。

**C2. θ=0.60 的 post-hoc 选择使 K*=2 核心结论脆弱** [R1-N1 + R2-W5, 交叉共识 AGREE]
- **位置**: Section 3.1, Figure 3, Section 4.1
- θ=0.60 是在观察 1v2 和 2v3 AUC 分布后选择的 post-hoc 阈值。4/7 continuation-mode 配置 CI lower bound 距 θ 不足 1pp（Qwen-cont 仅 0.2pp，OLMo-1B 仅 0.5pp），θ 上移 0.5pp 即可翻转多个 K* 判定。AUC=0.60 本身代表的分类能力很弱（仅略高于随机的 0.50）。R1 原评 critical，R2 原评 should-fix 后在交叉中同意升级。
- **建议**: 增加系统性 θ-sensitivity 表格（各配置在 θ∈{0.55, 0.575, 0.60, 0.625, 0.65} 下的 K*）；报告 Youden's J 选择的 θ_optimal 及对应 K*；Abstract/Conclusion 加入 "at θ=0.60" 的明确限定；讨论 AUC=0.60 对应的实际分类表现。

**C3. Prompt-chain 焦点与 model collapse 叙事之间的范围张力** [R2-N2, R1 AGREE with nuance]

- **建议**: Abstract/Conclusion 明确限定 "for models ≤14B"；Discussion 区分 K*_{15D} 和 K*_{intrinsic}。

### Reviewer 共识（Should-Fix，7 项）

**W1. 跨模型迁移的 boundary-level 失败需更充分讨论** [R1, R2 AGREE]
Section 4.2 报告 4/6 off-diagonal 7B pairs 在 boundary 级别失败，对生成模型未知的实际 curation 场景意味着 K* 估计不可靠。讨论仅限一句。建议 Section 6 增加段落分析实际影响及 multi-source pooling 缓解策略。

**W2. PELT changepoint 分析呈现具有误导性** [R1, R2 AGREE]
Exact agreement 仅 46%（K*∈{1,2,3} 量表上 ±1 chance level ~78%）。建议报告 Cohen's kappa，将 "validates" 降级为 "provides complementary evidence"。

**W3. Filtering 实验（Section 5）证据基础薄弱** [R1, R2 AGREE]
MMLU 改善约 0.76pp，仅覆盖 1-2 个下游任务。建议降级为 "preliminary case study"。Section 5 与前文缺过渡段。

**W4. K*=2 可能是 15D 特征空间的容量上限** [R1-Q3, R2-Q3 shared concern]

\section{Related Work}
\label{sec:related_work}

\paragraph{Model collapse and recursive degradation.}
Iterative training on model outputs causes tail-distribution degradation~\cite{shumailov2024collapse, alemohammad2024selfconsuming, dohmatob2024model, dohmatob2024demystified, dohmatob2025strong, seddik2024how}, diversity contraction~\cite{guo2024curious, padmakumar2024writing, briesch2023selfconsuming}, and predictable convergence~\cite{bertrand2024stability, schaeffer2025position, kazdan2025collapse, gerstgrasser2024model, shi2025collapse}.
Surplexity~\cite{gambetta2024surplexity} provides a single collapse indicator; our 15-dimensional features capture richer structure and enable transfer.
Curation can mitigate collapse~\cite{amin2025escaping}, connecting to Section~\ref{sec:filtering}; our prompt-chain operates in the replace regime~\cite{kazdan2025collapse}, making $\Kempirical{=}2$ a conservative lower bound.
This literature establishes convergence but provides no per-text depth measurement and does not predict domain-dependent saturation or the prompt-chain vs.\ retrain-chain gap ($\Kempirical{=}2$ vs.\ $7$).

\paragraph{Iterative generation dynamics.}
Mohamed et al.~\cite{mohamed2025telephone} study how information distorts across iterative generation chains, finding that degradation accumulates with chain length.
Geng et al.~\cite{geng2026markovian} formalize iterative generation as Markovian chains and show that outputs converge to small cycle sets.
Wang et al.~\cite{wang2025attractor} show that successive paraphrasing converges to low-period attractor cycles, suggesting a dynamical-systems view; the attractor entry depth may correspond to the discrimination boundary, though this parallel remains suggestive.
Gillman et al.~\cite{gillman2024selfcorrecting} propose self-correcting mechanisms for self-consuming loops.
Shahriar et al.~\cite{shahriar2025erosion} report a 25.4\% decline in detection performance after five paraphrasing rounds, consistent with our finding that discrimination collapses within two to three generations.
While these works characterize \emph{whether and when} outputs converge (a dynamical-systems question), none provides a per-text operational depth estimate; $\Kempirical$ measures \emph{at which depth} adjacent generations become statistically indistinguishable (an operational discrimination question).

\paragraph{Beyond binary detection.}
Binary detectors~\cite{gehrmann2019gltr, mitchell2023detectgpt, bao2024fast, yang2024dnagpt, hans2024binoculars, verma2024ghostbuster, basani2026diveye, zhang2024minkpp, hu2023radar, tulchinskii2024intrinsic} achieve strong human-vs.-machine separation but produce no depth estimate; surveys~\cite{wu2023survey, tang2024science} consolidate this landscape but frame detection as binary.
Recent work extends beyond binary labels to collaboration degree~\cite{cheng2025beyond}, contamination hierarchies~\cite{mehta2025beyond}, and multigenerator benchmarks~\cite{wang2024semeval}; robustness concerns arise under paraphrasing~\cite{sadasivan2023detect, krishna2023paraphrasing} and cross-mode transfer~\cite{hao2025rewrite}; CoDeC~\cite{zawalski2026codec} addresses contamination via membership inference.
None estimates recursive generation depth.
Watermarking~\cite{kirchenbauer2023watermark} embeds detectable signals at generation time but does not apply to text already in the wild.

\paragraph{Distributional quality metrics.}
MAUVE~\cite{pillutla2021mauve, pillutla2023mauve} measures corpus-level distributional closeness but not multi-generational degradation; $\Kempirical$ complements such metrics by localizing per-text depth saturation.

\paragraph{Data selection and curation.}
DSIR~\cite{xie2023dsir}, D4~\cite{tirumala2023d4}, DoReMi~\cite{xie2023doremi}, and FineWeb~\cite{penedo2024fineweb} address corpus quality through domain-aware filtering but are depth-agnostic; \citet{drayson2025} combined binary detection with importance resampling ($\Kstar{=}1$); \citet{oren2024proving} address pre-training contamination without depth-granular resolution.

\paragraph{Ordinal classification and probing.}
Our surprisal features build on information-theoretic processing cost~\cite{hale2001surprisal, levy2008expectation}, repurposed to track generational degradation.
Our OBD classifier follows Frank \& Hall's~\cite{frank2001ordinal} binary decomposition; CORAL~\cite{cao2020coral} provides a rank-consistent neural alternative.
Our neural probe extends probing~\cite{alain2017understanding, belinkov2022probing} to the discrimination boundary.
